# Marco Wang

> Marco Wang is a software engineer based in San Francisco, building conversational AI agents at Sierra.

This is Marco's personal portfolio. Previously, he worked at rabbit, Exa, The Boring Company, Workiva, and NU Tiilt Lab. This summary uses the public About page; the linked pages contain the full portfolio and context.

## Pages

- [About](https://www.marcowang.me/about): Current introduction and background.
- [Spotlight](https://www.marcowang.me/spotlight): Selected projects, including Scribe, Tomo, and Igloo.
- [Collection](https://www.marcowang.me/collection): Full project collection, descriptions, technologies, and source/demo links. Some projects are marked work in progress.
- [Resume](https://www.marcowang.me/resume): Work experience, education, and downloadable resume.
- [Contact](https://www.marcowang.me/contact): Public professional profiles and contact information.
